title: Ask Only, "O My Lord! Increase Me in Knowledge"
body:
Madad, yaa Sayyidee. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) La ilaaha illa-Llah. La ilaaha illa-Llah. La ilaaha illa-Llah
Muhammadan Rasoolullah, `alayhi salaatullahi wa salaam wa `ala sayyid al-anbiya wa 'l-awliya wa 'ssaaliheen. Yaa Rabbi 'l-`Alameen! Zidna........ warda `anna w `afoo `anna w 'aghfir lanaa w 'arhamna wa tub
`alayna.....waslih shanaana wa shaan al-muslimeen ..., sultaan al-insi wal jinn, Sayyidina Mahdi,
ayyadahullah, ashaarahullah!
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. Ayyuha 'l-ghaafiloon, ayyuha
'l-jaahiloon, ayyuha at-taagheen, ayyuha at-tughaat, O heedless ones! O ignorant ones! O oppressors! Keep
your positions! Try to keep your promise on the Day of Resurrection and say, a`oodhu billahi min ashShaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem! Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem! (Mawlana Shaykh
sits) Thumma 's-salaam `ala Saahib az-Zamaan, thumma 's-salaam `ala Saahib al-Mutassarif fi 'd-dunya
kamaa yuhibbu rabbunaa wa yardaa!•
O People! All of us know nothing, but we must try to learn. All of us must try to understand our missions, for
what have we been created. O our attenders from Mankind and Jinn! We have a responsibility in the Divine
Presence. Don't forget the Day of Promises, when we said, "O our Lord, You are Allah, our Creator, and we
are giving our oath that we are Your servants and not servants for anyone else." O our Lord, help us to fulfill

our oath.
O our Attenders! Why have we been ordered to fast? O Salafi `ulamas, make it clear to all nations from Arabs
and for everyone else. We must make it clear for all Mankind, that for which purpose have we given our oath
to our Lord Almighty. Make it clear and say first to Arabs: because Allah Almighty is sending His most
respected and honored and glorified one. For which purpose? What do you think, O Salafi `ulamas? Who was
Allah Almighty addressing and speaking to? For the sake of Allah, say!
O Wahhabi People! You no-mind ones! Say, to whom was Allah Almighty addressing and speaking on the
Day of pre-Eternal? Salafi `ulamas, say! Make it clear to all nations! Is Allah speaking or not, or was Allah
speaking in His Eternity or not? Was He sitting like me and thinking? What do you think? Our brothers, say
and make it clear! You must make everything clear. Don’t say, “We are `ulamas, we are Wahhabi `ulamas.” If
you are Wahhabi people, I am asking you, to whom was Allah Almighty addressing and speaking? Allah
Almighty addressed that most glorified one, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) I
am very astonished and asking you, when Allah Almighty addressed, was He speaking through pre-Eternal,
and was He standing or sitting?
O Jewish Rabbis! What is your understanding? When Allah Almighty addressed Moses (a), was He sitting or
standing? What do you think? Was He sitting under an olive tree? Say, rabbis! Where are you? You are
saying, “We are Jewish people, and the most important prophet was Moses." I am asking you, so say! When
Allah Almighty addressed Moses (a) on Mount Sinai, was He standing up? Was Allah standing, and Moses
sitting, or was Allah sitting and Moses standing? What do you think, rabbis? Say! Don’t say, “We are rabbis
and we know everything.” Such a question is coming now. Say! Who is your Lord and what are His Divinely
Attributes?
And I am asking the same question from Salafi `ulamas. I am asking also those no-mind Wahhabi people,
who claim they know everything and who say, “Our knowledge is the highest knowledge.” Say! If you have
highest knowledge, how was Allah Almighty addressing on the Day of Eternity in His Eternal Kingdom, and
how was He speaking on the Day of Eternity and pre-Eternal? He addressed someone, (Mawlana Shaykh
stands) a`ti kullu dhi haqqin haqqah, “Give to each one the rights he is due.” Is it true or not? (Mawlana
Shaykh sits) That is an ocean! From one drop of that ocean the whole Creation will sink! What was Allah

Almighty's order to the Seal of Prophets (s) on the Day of Promises? Say! And on which thing did we give our
oaths to our Lord, our Creator, Allah Almighty? (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbaru 'l-Akbar! (Mawlana
Shaykh sits)
Make it clear! The time is over, and the whole Judgment Day is coming to make everything clear. What was
Allah Almighty's oath on the Day of Promises? To whom was He addressing? Which one can be able to stand
up in His Divinely Presence and hear? It is impossible. Only that chosen one may, who is His real deputy
from pre-Eternal up to Eternal, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) Al-`ilmu
bahrun, Knowledge Oceans are countless! And it is not something granted for the honor of the Seal of
Prophets (s), from Allah Almighty's Endless Oceans? There are no limits for Allah Almighty's Knowledge
Oceans! All oceans in existence can't be even the smallest spot beside Allah Almighty's Knowledge Oceans!
Say! For what are we coming there now? You must say, O you who are claiming, "We know everything." If
you know everything, why are you hiding it, why are you not teaching people? And one who is nothing is
asking such a question, that from whom was the Lord of Heavens taking His first oath? Allah Almighty is
never going to be occupied with anything, hasha, impossible! As you know, laa yushghilahu shaanun `an
shaan, "Nothing can occupy Allah Almighty's Divinely Sifaat, Attributes. No one can know about His
attributes except Him, He knows. No one knows, it is impossible! But the Lord of Heavens asked to give
honor to those creatures that He Almighty created with His Divinely Hands and gave them a model, that is
dressed upon them from His Divinely Attributes to be suitable. More than this, He is addressing Sayyidina
Muhammad (s), to be fully honored, so that he can convey Allah Almighty's addressing to them. Do you think
that a majestic king is addressing his servant? It is not honor for a majestic king to speak to a servant, nor it is
suitable for a servant mukhaatab, to speak directly with a king. Therefore, Allah Almighty used the Seal of
Prophets (s), and all the prophets take from him. He was suitable, as the Lord of Heavens addressed His most
beloved and glorified one on a level that no one else is able, or they will perish and disappear. That power is
only granted to the Seal of Prophets (s)! No one can stand up while the Lord of Heavens addresses him, and
His addressing is according to His most beloved servant's level! Yes, such things they are making to become
more clear about the honor of the Seal of Prophets (s).
All Wahhabi peoples' understanding is on the lowest level and they are saying, "We are not accepting that one
over our levels." And that is their wrong position, a wrong point in their beliefs, to look at the Seal of Prophets

(s) as being like themselves or on the same level as them. That is their biggest mistake! Therefore, to all
`ulamas, we are saying now, you must correct your beliefs. You can't say this about that one's levels. No one
can understand his level because no one is granted what he is granted from his Lord!
O People! O `ulamas! We are asking, on the Day of Promises, was the Lord of Heavens sitting or standing?
What do you think? And was He sitting on the Throne? Which throne can seat its Lord? How? He created the
Holy Throne, and until He created it, where was He, standing up or waiting? Which builders were building it?
Angels? And Who created angels? So many questions.
O Wahhabi people! You are no-mind people, not understanding anything. And Salafi `ulamas must try to
understand a little bit more, as much as possible about the "Day of Promises". What happened on that day?
How did it happen? And on that day what form were we in? We were there and He was taking our oath. What
do you think? Which one was able to take an oath directly from their Lord? It can't be, or they will be taken
away from existence and thrown in the endless oceans of the Heavens!
O People! All these things are to make a new understanding stage for people, because the Day of Resurrection
is just approaching and we must be prepared with such heavenly powers to be able to stand up on Judgement
Day in the Divine Presence, to be given something for the honor of the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina
Muhammed (s). (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
O our `ulamas! There is something that we are not yet prepared to understand. It is shown as a project, but
no one knows its realities. One question, Salafi `ulamas, I am not saying to Wahhabi people because they are
no-mind people, never understanding anything; I am asking the ones who claim they are "Salafi `ulamas."
What is Allah Almighty saying in the Holy Qur'an through His most beloved representative, and who was that
one? Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands) He is ordering, "O My most special one! Don't ask
anything from Me except, ••• •••••• ••••••• •••••••
qul Rabbee zidnee `ilma, "Say, 'O my Lord! Increase me in knowledge.'" (20:114) (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
What do you think of people that are running after more gold, more oil, and more treasures? Put them in the
WC center! The Lord of Heavens was ordering His most beloved one, Rabbee zidnee `ilma! Which kind of
knowledge was He talking about, when His beloved was granted a complete knowledge of Creation?
Everywhere, whatever has been created, the Seal of Prophets (s) was fully knowing it as a grant from his

Lord. Yet, Allah Almighty said, “O My beloved one! Ask from Me more than I already gave you!”
And Prophet (s) said, “O my Lord! Give me more and more from Knowledge Oceans. I am thirsty, give me
more and more , making me more suitable in front of Your Lordship, to give more and endless majesty and
praising of Your Divine Presence, about which we only know something!”
But who may reach the real being of Allah Almighty's Glorified and Majestic Dominions? No one! (Mawlana
Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbaru 'l-Akbar! Allahu Akbaru 'l-Akbar! Allahu Akbaru 'l-Akbar! Rabbee zidnee
`ilma wa hilma, for the honor of Your most honoured one! (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Fatihah.
(40 minutes) Yaa Rabbee, shukran.
(Mawlana Shaykh speaks with Hajjah Naziha and Shaykh Hisham Effendi on the phone.)
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two raka`at Salaat ash-Shukr.)
